code_hash_encoding: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF

protocol.objective: unweighted original-Loss MSE; equal Q rows per N,D cluster
protocol.selection: lowest mean of three axis-mean held-level RMSE; descriptive model selection, not nested unbiased evaluation

bootstrap.unit: N,D cluster, all Q kept together
bootstrap.scope: conditional on selected model and semi-synthetic B7; not independent training runs or total prediction uncertainty
